name: pi-runner
description: Pi Runner — a polished 2D Pi-themed endless runner. Deterministic C++ core compiled to WebAssembly, TypeScript shell, and a hardened Node/Express backend with Pi login, optional cosmetic payments, and a re-simulated (anti-cheat) leaderboard.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:js
